function.description: Calculate the area of a triangle given its base and height. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit.description: The unit of measure (defaults to 'units' if not specified)

function.name: get_case_info
function.description: Retrieve case details using a specific case docket number and court location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

docket.description: Docket number for the specific court case.

court.description: Court in which the case was heard.

info_type.description: Specify the information type needed for the case. i.e., victim, accused, verdict etc.
